name: earnusdc-usdc
notes: admin is a temporary operator key; it hands over to the final admin with the pool's two-step propose_admin/accept_admin transfer.
pool: arguments to PoolFactory.deploy (salt is chosen at deploy time). oracle is a pool_oracle_adapter over a Templar proxy runtime.
min_collateral is effective (c_factor-weighted) collateral in 7-decimal oracle base units: 10000000000 = 1,000 USD.

usdc IRM at ir_mod = 1: 4% at U=0, 8% at 85%, 10% at 90%, 12% at 95%, 112% at 100%. reactivity 100 moves ir_mod (bounded 0.1x-10x) toward target: below 85% the curve decays to as little as a tenth, above it scales up to 10x below 95% and adds up to 9x of (r_base + r_one + r_two) above.
Borrows stop at max_util 90%; withdrawals may push U to just under 100%, which is where r_three applies.

earnusdc is a custom Soroban token (unverified wasm 4b3d9f6b...), 13 decimals per its on-chain decimals(). Collateral only; r_base 1000 is the contract minimum. min_position = 10 earnUSDC. Liquidation incentive tops out at (1 - c_factor) / 2 = 5%.

Oracle: the proxy runtime requires 3-16 sources per asset, all against one base, with min_sources >= 3. The RedStone feeds above are one source; earnUSDC (and USDC) each need at least two more before activation.
Immutable after setup: update_pool is disabled and reserves only accept disabling, so caps, IRM, factors, max_positions and min_collateral are permanent.
set_status 0 checks the backstop threshold; it is met by this pool's own activation stack (own factory, Comet, emissions-disabled backstop and synthetic no-value BLND/USDC legs), not real capital.
